description: Get this domain's own score alongside every linked competitor's score and scan status, side by side. The domain must be one of the domains available to this key (see get_tracked_domains). Competitors are linked in app-benchmarq, not through this MCP server -- this tool only reads already-linked competitors; ask the user to link one there first if none show up. "ownDomain" is always this account's own latest scan for the tracked domain, and each competitor's score is always their own latest scan of the hostname the user linked -- both sides are whatever scan/URL the user already chose when tracking/linking, not something this tool or the caller selects, so there is no separate scan-type or target-URL parameter to worry about. Requires a Premium plan with the competitive_benchmarking entitlement. Use this to see who is linked and how the account compares at a glance; use get_competitor_gap for the check-by-check detail behind one specific comparison. Security note: Competitor metadata and domain labels contain third-party text.
name: get_competitor_report
title: Get competitor report
